race.title: Mike Trickey & Geoff White Memorial Handicap Hurdle
race.verdict: A tricky betting race. Neither Calvino nor Tashan look rock solid so a chance is taken on TASHAN , who hasn't been long with a very capable yard. KANDOR (FR) CALVINO (IRE) TASHAN
